title: Decision record
description: A specification owner's answers to what their specification leaves open, one per question, kept beside the specification. A draft cites an answer by its id (sce:assumed="<id>"), and `decisions` holds the draft to it. Each answered decision is a sentence the specification should have said.

specification.description: Which specification these are answers for. Informative: the acceptance record pins the specification's files by content, and this names them for a reader.

decisions.description: Every question asked of the owner, answered or not. An id appears once.

id.description: What a draft writes in sce:assumed or sce:unresolved to cite this decision. One token: a marker id holds no space.

anchor.description: The clause the question is about. A new question a draft asks is shown beside every recorded one on the same clause, so the owner can say whether it is one they already answered.

answer.description: The owner's answer, in their words. Absent while the question is still open; a draft may then only ask it (sce:unresolved), not guess it.

candidates.description: The values the answer could have been, where it is a value.

chosen.description: Which candidate the answer is, where it is a value. A draft's decision variable citing this decision has to hold it.

anchor.description: The shape of the product's `spec_provenance` record (`sce-codegen requirements`): the same fields a document's sce:provenance is read into.
